title: Damsin and neoambrosin: Two sesquiterpene lactones with affinity and different activity for PPAR and TRPA1 receptors.
authors: Abdel-Dayem, Shymaa I A; Otify, Asmaa M; Iannotti, Fabio Arturo; Saber, Fatema R; Moriello, Aniello Schiano; Giovannuzzi, Simone; Swiatek, Lukasz; Bonardi, Alessandro; Gratteri, Paola; Skalicka-Wozniak, Krystyna; Supuran, Claudiu T
one_liner_zh: 该文研究两种倍半萜内酯对PPAR和TRPA1受体的亲和力与活性，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: Ambrosia maritima L. (family Asteraceae) is an annual herb widely distributed throughout the Mediterranean region and Africa. The herb is employed in folk medicine for the treatment of many ailments. Herein, we report a comprehensive investigation of the diverse biological potential of two sesquiterpene lactones, damsin and neoambrosin, isolated from Ambrosia maritima. 1D and 2D NMR and HR-ESI-MS/MS were employed to characterize the chemical structures of both compounds. In order to identify biological targets of both compounds we investigated their potential affinity for peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPARs) and transient receptor potential (TRP) channels, which are pleiotropic classes of receptors implicated in essential functions of the body. This was investigated using a luciferase assay and a calcium fluorometric assay. A carbonic anhydrase inhibition assay was also performed using stopped flow CO(2) hydrase spectrophotometric assay. Our analysis revealed that unlike damsin, neoambrosin showed a selective partial agonist effect on PPARgamma receptors and TRPA1 channels. Its binding mode was investigated through in silico analysis. Both compounds showed no affinity for the tested carbonic anhydrases. Overall, our study details the chemical properties of neoambrosin and damsin and highlights neoambrosin as novel, cost-effective partial agonist of PPARɣ and TRPA1 receptors despite additional in vivo studies are needed to elucidate its biological and pharmacological properties.
abstract_zh: Ambrosia maritima L.（菊科）是一种一年生草本植物，广泛分布于地中海地区和非洲。该草药在民间医学中用于治疗多种疾病。在此，我们报告了对从Ambrosia maritima中分离出的两种倍半萜内酯damsin和neoambrosin的多种生物潜力的全面研究。采用1D和2D NMR及HR-ESI-MS/MS对两种化合物的化学结构进行了表征。为了确定两种化合物的生物靶点，我们研究了它们对过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPARs）和瞬时受体电位（TRP）通道的潜在亲和力，这些受体是参与身体基本功能的多效性受体类别。这通过荧光素酶测定和钙荧光测定进行了研究。还使用停流CO(2)水合酶分光光度法进行了碳酸酐酶抑制测定。我们的分析显示，与damsin不同，neoambrosin对PPARγ受体和TRPA1通道表现出选择性部分激动剂效应。其结合模式通过计算机模拟分析进行了研究。两种化合物对测试的碳酸酐酶均无亲和力。总体而言，我们的研究详细描述了neoambrosin和damsin的化学性质，并强调neoambrosin是PPARγ和TRPA1受体的新型、经济有效的部分激动剂，尽管仍需额外的体内研究来阐明其生物学和药理学特性。
